preflight.failure_policy: Stop on contract, identity, truncation, hidden-retry or BF16 parity failure. Do not fill unused budget with retries. Quantized action changes are observations, not automatic parity failures.
preflight.time_budget_scope: from first model load through final unload, including precision conversion, warmups and all decision evaluations; acquisition and dependency installation separately gated; incomplete preflight remains incomplete
preflight.deadline_enforcement: future supervisor must enforce wall and cumulative forward-call limits including warmups; no supervisor implemented here
preflight.quantized_export_reload_validation: required before persisted variants can be used; reserve unused calls only by a new reviewed preflight design, never exceed bounds
preflight.counting_unit: One native forward(enc) evaluation of the single move question. Prefix/branch subpasses are recorded separately; no extra decision calls are permitted.
